system.description:
Dedicates a place to a purpose: anyone there aligned with it may spend a Destiny Point to gain a chosen non-Sorcerous Benefit for an hour. Lasts until the sorcerer dies or moves it (permanent if a Destiny Point is burned), unless desecrated.

Ritual. Alignment: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 1 hour of hymns and chants, aided by an assistant who has the Benefit to be imbued. Invocation: Routine (6) or higher Persuasion; Difficulty and time depend on the area, from a 10-foot chamber (Routine 6, 30 minutes) to a cathedral or keep (Very Hard 18, 12 hours). Failure ruins the rite. Unleashing: Formidable (12) Will. Success also grants the Benefit freely for one day per degree; failure inflicts a drawback on everyone performing the rite.

Art of Benediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 93.
system.resonances: Extensive redecoration with fine materials and symbols (100 gold pieces), at a ritually auspicious time.
